experiment.claim: README.md 'Target specification (DRAFT)' row 'Iq' (< 50 uA), for the 3.3 V primary flavor (DR-001). Records are PROVISIONAL against the draft spec until issue #1 ratifies it. Measures the total current out of the single supply source feeding design/bandgap_core.sch (both core branches, the R2A/R2B legs and the error amplifier's mirrored tail), open-circuit at VREF, over the full 45-point PVT matrix.
experiment.title: Total quiescent supply current of the untrimmed core over the full PVT matrix

spread_checks.note: Iq must move by at least 1 uA across the 45-point matrix. A dead-flat current would mean the corner/temperature/supply knobs are not reaching the simulator -- the same liveness argument sim/pdk-smoke/ makes for the harness itself.
